TRIP PLAN — Japan, 19 Sep 2026 to 3 Oct 2026
Travellers: Nir, Ella, Noa, Maya, Shai (5 adults)

=== TOKYO — 19 Sep to 23 Sep ===
Hotel: OMO3 Asakusa by Hoshino Resorts, Chome-15-5 Hanakawado, Taito City, Tokyo
Check-in 19 Sep 15:00, check-out 23 Sep 11:00

Day 1 (19 Sep): Arrive Narita, train to Asakusa, hotel check-in. Evening walk to Senso-ji.
Day 2 (20 Sep):
  10:00  Tokyo Skytree observation decks (advance e-ticket)
  14:00  Lunch in Solamachi
  18:00  teamLab Planets, Toyosu (timed entry booked)
Day 3 (21 Sep): Free morning. Afternoon Meiji Shrine + Harajuku.
Day 4 (22 Sep): Day trip to Nikko (Toshogu Shrine). Return evening.

=== HAKONE — 23 Sep to 24 Sep ===
Hotel: Hakone Ashinoko Hanaori, Ashinoko lakeside
Day (23 Sep): Romancecar to Hakone-Yumoto. Open-Air Museum. Lake Ashi pirate cruise. Onsen at the ryokan.

=== KYOTO — 24 Sep to 27 Sep ===
Hotel: Cross Hotel Kyoto, Kawaramachi
Day 1 (24 Sep): Shinkansen Odawara to Kyoto. Fushimi Inari-taisha at dusk.
Day 2 (25 Sep):
  09:00  Sagano Romantic Train, board at Saga-Torokko station
  11:00  Hozugawa River boat ride, Kameoka to Arashiyama
  15:00  Arashiyama bamboo grove, Tenryu-ji
Day 3 (26 Sep): Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Nijo Castle.

=== OSAKA — 27 Sep to 30 Sep ===
Hotel: Hotel Royal Classic Osaka, Namba
Day 1 (27 Sep): Move to Osaka. 17:00 Grand Sumo tournament at Edion Arena (Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium).
Day 2 (28 Sep): Osaka Castle. Evening Dotonbori.
Day 3 (29 Sep): Day trip to Nara — Todai-ji, deer park.

=== TOKYO — 30 Sep to 3 Oct ===
Hotel: Shibuya Stream Hotel
Day (30 Sep): Return to Tokyo. Shibuya Sky at sunset. Last-night dinner.
2 Oct: Shopping in Ginza. 3 Oct: fly home from Haneda.
